incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH_ERROR_RATE for org=ratchett — 5xx surge, overall tail latency rising. Page sent to on-call Alex.

Alex (on-call): Ack. I'm on it. Looking at grafana -> ratchett shows ~8x normal QPS for the last 6m, error ratio -> 18%.

Alex (on-call): Topology: inbound routing shows ratchett pinned to cluster-eu-1. CPU on that pool is at 92%. KV cache hit drops.

Priya (sre): Can you narrow to model or endpoint? Is this new traffic pattern (long context) or retries?

Alex (on-call): Quick grep of logs: lots of identical calls from ratchett-api-1 with short intervals, same prompt hash. Client-side retry storm suspected. Body sizes normal.

Mateo (platform): If it's a hot retry storm, we should protect shared pools. Proposal: apply emergency org-level throttle for ratchett to reduce their RPS to a safe level and avoid global degradation. We can also enable their cached KV policy for quick wins.

Katie (CS): Heads-up — Ratchett is a paying enterprise. If we throttle them, CS needs to tell them. What are the rollback/compromise options?

Alex (on-call): Proposed immediate action (5m plan):
1) Apply per-org token rate limit: ratchett -> 50 req/s (down from ~400 req/s observed)
2) Enable aggressive leaky-bucket to smooth bursts (burst=80)
3) Add a 429 message with contact info + link to status page
4) Notify CS and AM (Katie) to contact customer about mitigation and next steps

Priya (sre): +1. Also we should prepare a dedicated dedicated throttle exception if customer requests higher throughput later (with opt-in dedicated capacity).

Mateo (platform): I can push the throttle via internal admin API. Command:```bash
# emergency per-org throttling
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/orgs/ratchett/rate_limits" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"type":"org","limit_rps":50,"burst":80,"reason":"emergency: noisy client causing cluster degradation","expires_in_s":1800}'
```I'll run this now and post result.

deploy-bot: Starting request to admin API (request_id=req_6f3a).

deploy-bot: 200 OK — throttle applied (rule_id=rl_zetra_809). Active in ~3s.

Alex (on-call): Throttle is live. Observing metrics... ratchett QPS dropped from ~410 -> ~48 over 60s. Error ratio for platform trending down. CPU usage on cluster-eu-1 falling to 74%.

Katie (CS): I'll ping the AM and send the standard incident notice: "We temporarily limited your request rate to protect platform stability; our team will work with you to identify cause and lift limits once mitigations are in place." Will follow up in thread.

Priya (sre): Create an incident ticket and assign follow-ups:
- label: org-throttle-hotfix
- RCA owner: Alex
- Postmortem owner: Mateo
- Customer comms: Katie
- Telemetry deep-dive: Priya

Alex (on-call): Quick sanity: adding a fallback policy so requests hitting the throttle return a clear 429 with X-RateLimit-Reset header. Command I used:```json
{"status":"throttled","http_code":429,"body":"Rate limit exceeded. Contact your AM or see status.redwood.ai/incidents/1802001111","headers":{"X-RateLimit-Reset":"+30s"}}
```

Mateo (platform): Also toggled 'cache-prefetch' for ratchett endpoints to reduce backend compute for repeated prompt patterns.

Priya (sre): Next steps for oncall handoff: Alex — collect minimal working repro and push to /incidents/ratchett artifact folder. Priya will take 1-2hr shift.

Alex (on-call): Copy. Uploading logs and sample request IDs now. Patch notes in ticket: https://tickets.internal/INC-4832 (added here for context).

Katie (CS): Customer replied (via AM): "We had a bug in our worker causing tight retries; we've deployed a fix. Please advise when you can lift the throttle."

Priya (sre): Ok — plan to test before complete rollback. Steps:
1) Keep throttle for 15m to let cluster recover
2) After AM confirms fix, run canary: set ratchett limit -> 150 rps for 5m, monitor errors/CPU
3) If stable, restore to nominal (or discuss dedicated capacity)

Alex (on-call): Initiating 15m hold timer. I'll handover to Priya at +20m.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rule rl_zetra_809 to auto-expire in 1800s unless extended.

Mateo (platform): Logging action for audit: change was made by Mateo (platform) via admin API, rule_id attached. Notifying infra-audit.

Priya (sre): On-call takeover in 20m. I've subscribed to the ticket and will watch dashboards.

Katie (CS): I'll coordinate customer comms and request a post-incident call. Will add AM notes to ticket.

Alex (on-call): Great teamwork — platform stabilizing. Will drop short summary in #postmortems after clean up. Passing to Priya for next steps. :thumbsup:

Priya (sre): Taking over. If anything spikes again, escalate to SEV team and consider temporary model fallback (lower-cost model) for ratchett if needed.

incidents-bot: Incident INC-4832 created and linked to this thread.

Mateo (platform): Added a short runbook fragment to internal doc: "emergency-org-throttle" with admin API snippets and communications template.

Katie (CS): Posting draft customer note in ticket for review.

Alex (on-call): Handing off — signing off.

Priya (sre): Acknowledged, continuing monitoring.
